title: Expense policy
text:
Employees may claim business expenses through the finance portal within 30 days of purchase. Receipts are required for any expense above 25 euros.

Meals while travelling are reimbursed up to 45 euros per day. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Taxis are allowed when public transport is unavailable or after 22:00.

Expenses above 1,000 euros need written approval from a department head before the purchase.

title: Remote work policy
text:
Staff may work remotely up to three days per week after completing their probation period. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 Central European Time.

Each remote employee receives a one-time home office allowance of 600 euros for a desk, chair and monitor. Working from another country for more than 30 days a year requires approval from People Operations because of tax and insurance rules.

title: Annual leave
text:
Full-time employees receive 28 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, plus public holidays. Up to five unused days may be carried over to the next year and must be used by 31 March.

Leave requests should be submitted in the HR system at least two weeks in advance for absences longer than three days. Sick leave is separate and requires a doctor's note after the third consecutive day.

title: Security incident response
text:
If you suspect a security incident, such as a phishing email, a lost laptop or leaked credentials, report it immediately in the #security-incidents channel and page the on-call security engineer.

Do not try to investigate on your own and do not delete suspicious emails, because they are evidence. Lost or stolen devices must also be reported to IT within one hour so they can be remotely wiped.

title: Password and access policy
text:
All accounts must use the company single sign-on with a hardware security key. Passwords for systems outside single sign-on must be at least 16 characters and stored in the company password manager.

Access to production systems is granted through just-in-time requests that expire after eight hours. Access reviews run every quarter, and unused permissions are removed automatically after 90 days.

title: Customer refund process
text:
Customers can request a refund within 14 days of delivery if the shipment arrived damaged or late by more than 48 hours. Support agents can approve refunds up to 200 euros directly in the support console.

Refunds above 200 euros are escalated to a team lead. Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within five business days.

title: Shipment tracking and delays
text:
Every shipment has a tracking code starting with NW followed by ten digits. Customers can follow it on the tracking page, which updates every 15 minutes.

When a shipment is delayed by more than 24 hours, the customer receives an automatic email with the new estimated delivery date. Delays caused by customs are excluded from the late-delivery guarantee.

title: Onboarding checklist
text:
In their first week, new hires meet their buddy, set up their laptop with IT, enrol a hardware security key and complete the security awareness training.

By the end of the first month they should have shipped a small change to production and had a check-in with their manager. Probation lasts six months and ends with a formal review.
